Validation and execution audit

Research-only comparison: Base/config minimum closes 10 and validation Last-10 instead of 12; these are not the default settings. Eight symbols · Prehistory: 8 October 12:00–9 October 00:00 UTC · Trading: 9 October 00:00–12:00 UTC · modeled round-trip cost: 0.15%.

Not ready for live trading. This previously examined market window is retrospective. A controlled conflict case reproduces a raw-candidate versus processed-set validation mismatch; the persistent Base → Main → Real adapter is not integrated. Its regression remains an expected failure. The results below are modeled; exchange PF is unavailable. A positive aggregate does not establish consistently positive hours or future performance.

Measured cohorts

Initial validation is a single snapshot, not the subsequent execution sample. The historical mean excludes true no-loss sets and labels them separately. PF = gross positive unit returns ÷ gross negative unit returns; exactly 1.00 is neutral. Empty or flat samples are unavailable, not neutral. NL = positive returns without any losses; it is not the engine’s finite gate score.

Scope and checks

All enabled Base indication/bot combinations were requested, with a bounded protection grid and the existing EMA, MACD and RSI Signal sources. Report coverage: 74/76 checks. Only 20/21 indication kinds and 27,284/42,366 expected combinations were evaluated. The low-range indication kind was not evaluated; 15m and 30m lanes had too few bars for the 120-bar production minimum in this history. Long-side closes: 2116; short-side closes: 0. Other strategy types with no closes have no execution PF.

All 2116 funded-model settled orders matched their exact source identities and returns after removing the external sizing multiplier once. This is a changed-gate experiment, not an identical-settings parity comparison. 857 ordinary closes were price/cost checked; DCA cost behavior is covered by separate deterministic tests. Intrabar ordering and exchange fills were not verified here.

Worst reported processing slice: 1,864 ms; target: <500 ms. Peak child RSS: 695.0 MiB. Full run exited with status 1 because the two coverage checks failed.
